entities.summary: Anna Costenoble (1866–1930) was a German artist during the Symbolism art movement. Her primary artistic mediums are prints and paintings, with works featuring portraits, landscapes, and women as subjects. Despite the fact that her works remain unknown and unseen by many, Costenoble had a long and prosperous career as an artist.
